title: The least Type 1 cubic graphs without equitable 4-total colorings have order 16
scope: The frozen assertion is false. Among connected simple cubic graphs of order below 20, the minimum order of a Type 1 graph with no equitable proper 4-total coloring is 16; there are exactly 16 such isomorphism classes at that least order, with the canonical graph6 codes listed in evidence/disproof.md.
